Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: This step fabricated a conclusion by inferring pre-7am classes from early opening hours and claiming “Based on the search results” without any schedule data, violating Rule 2 (fabrication/misinterpretation at the point of production). It also failed to enforce the <200m constraint and duplicated entries, and by issuing an “ANSWER” it became the first point after which the speculative result was propagated, satisfying Rule 3 as the decisive misstep.
